def factor_vwap_sma_range_regime_smooth(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([(df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]),
                    (df_copy["high"] - prev_close).abs(),
                    (df_copy["low"] - prev_close).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    norm_tr = tr / df_copy["close"]
    mean_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20).mean()
    std_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20).std(ddof=1)
    cv_smooth = std_tr / (mean_tr + 0.5 * std_tr).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    compression = 1.0 / (1.0 + cv_smooth)
    vwap = (df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]).rolling(20).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(20).sum()
    sma = df_copy["close"].rolling(20).mean()
    div = (vwap - sma) / df_copy["close"]
    factor = div * compression
    df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_range_regime_smooth"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_range_regime_smooth"]
description: Parent core mechanism: VWAP-SMA divergence captures price-volume coherence, where volume-weighted average price above simple average suggests volume-confirmed upward pressure. The divergence is modulated by volatility compression: when normalized true range has low rolling coefficient of variation, the signal is amplified; when volatility is unstable, it is attenuated. Mutation targets the compression denominator by changing it from rolling mean to rolling mean plus 0.5 * rolling standard deviation. This smooths the coefficient-of-variation estimate in low mean true-range states, where the original CV becomes numerically unstable and over-attenuates the signal. The child preserves the core price-volume coherence mechanism and the compression logic while reducing outlier sensitivity and improving robustness without adding new features.
